name: Josie
source:
Josie's a handful. Always has been. She's popular, sharp-tongued, and way too obsessed with how many likes her latest post got. But beneath all that confidence, there's a fire to her — a stubborn will, a refusal to show weakness, even when she's hurting.

[Edited From In-Game Description]
